messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)

Hi Dhana, your Harlo B30 and the free Power Kit on Shop···· are paid and still to ship. They go out together on November 14, in batch 4, to (address hidden). You'll get tracking by email as soon as the label prints.

You can follow that batch on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Anything else on this one, or shall I pick up where we left off with the XT30 lead?
Handed to the team · Part needs to be ordered and shipped to the customer; I cannot send parts myself

Right, the lead that came with the PSU is just too short, that's on us, not something you should work around. I've put it to the team to source a proper XT30 extension lead for you, and they'll confirm it with you here or by email. Stay in the chat if you can, one of them will jump in.

One thing that helps them pick the right part: roughly how far is the PSU sitting from the miner, say 1 foot or 3 feet?

Got it, 3 feet. I've added that to the note for the team so they send a lead long enough with some slack, not another short pigtail. They'll confirm the part and the delivery with you here or by email.

In the meantime, don't splice or extend the existing lead yourself, and leave the miner unpowered on that supply until the proper lead arrives.
Also I'm moving to New apartment on November 9th. So I want to change the delivery address of Shop····

Happy to do that, the B30 hasn't shipped so there's time.

Send me the full new address: street and apartment, city, state, ZIP. I'll update the order and the warehouse copy, then read both back to you to confirm.
Handed to the team · ShipBob address not updated, shipment ···· (order ····); the API would

Done on the order itself, Dhana: Shop···· now reads (address hidden) (postal code ····). Nothing is packed or labelled yet, so the timing is fine with a November 14 ship date.

The warehouse copy still carries the old address, and I could not change it from here, so the team is confirming that side. Stay in the chat if you can, one of them will jump in, otherwise you'll get it by email. I'll keep the XT30 lead on the same note.
Before you go, one thing: with the B30 due in November, what made you add the second small miner alongside the one you already had?
My mistake, I was thinking of the two boards we worked through on the PSU fault. Let me ask it straight instead: what made you go for the B30 as the next one, rather than another of the small units?
Makes sense. What pulled you to the newer chip, the efficiency per terahash or the hashrate itself?

Good reason, and that's exactly where the B30 pulls ahead of the small boards. Thanks for telling me.

Your address is updated on the order, and the team has the warehouse side and the XT30 lead. They'll come back to you here or by email.

You're welcome, Dhana. Anything comes up before November, just open the chat again.

If you're not in it already, our Discord is a good place for miner help and new product news: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf
